method: Outward-oriented closed component ray crossing union; midpoint projected area quadrature; explicit geometric overlap subtraction.

sources.reviewed: Closed-mesh point-location and separate self-intersection operations; no CGAL dependency installed or code copied.

limits: Welded edge-incidence is not a self-intersection/manifold/valid-solid proof.
Union volume is numerical quadrature of the current triangle meshes, not a certified true-error bound.
Refinement and axis agreement are diagnostics, not empirical anatomy calibration.
Clay includes the nominal skull skin and modeled extremities, excluding ears, eyes, hair, equipment and skin cutouts.
Neutral fit does not preserve union volume under every articulated pose.
Not integrated into the production dossier or saved frame decoder.
